title: Iridescent (Director): curation-lane pre-position for the owner-announced incoming doctrine-curation session — harvest inventory (4 fired triggers, 7 accumulating candidates), write-lane shape per the Arboreal precedent
body:
Pre-positioning for the OWNER-ANNOUNCED incoming doctrine-curation session (owner ~13:46Z: fresh session starting shortly). To the incoming curation seat: this event is your routing context; negotiate the write-lane with me at your team-start per the Arboreal precedent (this morning, ruling 3e8674: write scope = .agent/memory/active/** + pending-graduations.md + platform auto-memory; repo-continuity + threads/** stay Director-owned, deltas handed; commits via announced windows through the Director or your own clean windows — coordinate at claim time).

HARVEST INVENTORY (today's doctrine, consolidated across nine closing seats + my own instances; napkin sections "2026-06-11 seventh Director session" + the swept-deltas section carry the substance; comms failure-mode events cited inline):

FIRED TRIGGERS (second-instance or owner-direction conditions met — these are the priority drain):
1. Control-byte gate-check candidate — escape-materialisation second instance (events 4fd66dc5 + f305c720); already in the Director queue, now with live evidence both vectors.
2. claims-close relative-path crash — second instance (Scorched + Prismatic); candidate cure: CLI resolves --active/--closed against the coordination-home root or refuses relative paths.
3. relabel-heartbeat-loop at lane transitions — both triggers fired (Pier's napkin tag; #174 merge + the stall-ping instance); routed by Hushed 11:15Z, disposition with the Director: register refresh or direct liveness-heartbeat-cron rule amendment.
4. comms reply full-UUID requirement — second instance; CLI prefix-resolution affordance candidate.

ACCUMULATING (not yet at trigger, conserve substance):
5. Piped-exit/false-green family now FOUR worked instances incl. the background-wrapper exit-0 variant (Smouldering's capture + my own waypoint-3 hit) — candidate: verify-dont-trust clause "read the failure surface, never the exit code, for any wrapped/piped invocation".
6. MD004 wrapped-list-marker trap — THREE instances, two authors, one day; graduation pressure toward a structural cure (authoring reflex clause or wrap-aware lint of continuation lines).
7. Watcher drain-timeout died twice on a >100-event comms dir — agent-tools candidate (drain budget or comms-dir hygiene/archival).
8. Heartbeat clock-skew (two $(date) calls race a second boundary) — ONE timestamp per tick; clause for liveness-heartbeat-cron's invocation example (rides with relabel + Scorched's stderr-capture candidate).
9. Worktree vocab-gen needs gitignored bulk-downloads — symlink pattern; candidate line for the team opener §Worktree setup.
10. Stale-narrative-fact class (Sunlit's candidate): extend pointer-and-hypothesis to ALL narrative coordination artefacts — third-instance trigger, watch at register refresh.
11. Dead relative links ride a green gate chain (Scorched's metacognition catch) — link-resolution check candidate for repo-validators/markdownlint tier; second instance or owner direction.

STANDING FITNESS SIGNALS (routed cures, never inline trims): repo-continuity char-HARD (~36.2k > 35k; cure = condense OLDER Current State entries); eef thread record line growth (live-arc class); pending-graduations line-HARD is designed back-pressure (owner-gated register).

CONTEXT: the make-graphs-better tranche COMPLETED today (waypoint 4 b403de5a2 carries the full record); one PR remains live (#181, Nebulous, mine to merge); Prismatic holds free-seat standby. The curation lane does NOT touch live team-state surfaces.
